cleansingStrength.rationale: Strong: primary non-ethoxylated alkyl sulfate (Ammonium Lauryl Sulfate #2) as the chassis, betaine only after salt (Cocamidopropyl Betaine #4), charcoal powder #9 adsorbent route, light conditioning. C1 covers ether sulfates buffered by betaine; ALS is the stronger primary anionic and the formula carries reset/deep-cleansing intent, so the C1 moderate rule does not apply. Net effect remains strong after the Nigella Sativa Seed Oil #5 refatting counter-signal.
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: Betaine buffering and an early seed oil refatter (#5) could net to moderate.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: two light routes - cationic Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride #8 and an early lipid refatter Nigella Sativa Seed Oil #5 - plus Polyglycerin-10 #11 humectant; no silicone or fatty alcohol. Noticeable but bounded rinse-off care.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: Strong ALS chassis and a single polymer could read as cleansing-led low.

weightPotential.rationale: Low: light guar #8 and an oil refatter #5 in a strong ALS chassis with no silicone or fatty alcohol; the oil is not persistent against this reset capacity.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Light, low-persistence deposition offset by strong reset.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Moderate would need a meaningfully persistent system; an early nonvolatile oil (#5) plus guar is the realistic route to moderate, so it is recorded as neighbor.
weightPotential.counterSignal: Seed oil at #5 is prominent, not late.

focusPrimary.rationale: Clarifying: name 'Ausgleichendes Shampoo Anziehende Aktivkohle' and the manufacturer's lead claim 'Tiefenreinigungsshampoo, das schnell fettende Kopfhaut reinigt' make deep-cleaning/oily-root the dominant job; strong ALS + charcoal architecture is compatible (7.2 'explicit deep-cleaning/reset product with compatible architecture').

careDirection.limitation: Primary is not a repair/moisture decision; the competing moisture claim is assessed under focusSecondary.

focusPrimary.counterSignal: Equal-weight '72 h Feuchtigkeit für trockene Längen' claim.
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Blind: strong ALS chassis, light conditioning, oil refatter -> clarifying-compatible. Unblind: name + 'Tiefenreinigungsshampoo' + oily scalp -> clarifying; moisture claim is secondary and fails its formula verdict.

focusSecondary.rationale: Empty: the distinct dry-lengths moisture claim lacks an independent route - care-direction verdict nonspecific (one humectant, Polyglycerin-10 #11, is not a coherent humectant cluster; the oil #5 and guar #8 are generic conditioning). F1: moisture language over a nonspecific formula does not become moisture.
focusSecondary.counterSignal: Explicit '72 h Feuchtigkeit' positioning on all sources.

usageRole.rationale: Occasional_reset: the manufacturer's primary claim names the product a 'Tiefenreinigungsshampoo' (D1 lexicon 'Tiefenreinigung'), cleansing is strong and focus is clarifying (§9 occasional_reset, 13.6 D1). Directions do not restrict frequency.
usageRole.counterSignal: No frequency limitation in directions; retailer copy omits the deep-cleansing label; dual moisture positioning reads as an everyday product.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Not targeted: no sensitive/itchy/dry-scalp positioning; strong ALS reset and fragrance are counter-signals; no comfort route.

dandruffSupport.rationale: Neither Piroctone Olamine nor Climbazole in the complete INCI.

projection.thicknessRationale: T1 with W low, C moderate: fine ideal, normal ideal, coarse acceptable. T6 lifts nothing. T4: W neighbor moderate would make fine acceptable (lower) -> review_thickness_boundary (fine); normal stays ideal at W moderate; coarse stays acceptable under either neighbor.
projection.scalpTargetRationale: S-OILY: E2 oily claim 'schnell fettende Kopfhaut' on the exact manufacturer page (E1 moderate; name has 'Ausgleichend' only). Formula: cleansing strong, W low, C moderate -> pass. Confidence = min(moderate positioning, cleansing moderate, W moderate, C moderate) = moderate. 'Trockene Haarlängen' is a length claim and never creates a dry target (E2, S-DRY).
projection.cleansingIntensityRationale: I1: strong + occasional_reset + clarifying primary -> clarifying (differs from oily bucket's expected regular; I2 keeps it). I3: neighbor moderate -> regular, which equals the oily bucket's expected intensity while the current one does not -> review_intensity_boundary.
projection.deepCleanserRationale: D1 true via manufacturer primary claim 'Tiefenreinigungsshampoo' (E1 moderate). D2: strong + clarifying primary + occasional_reset + D1 -> flagged. Regular-shampoo rows kept (D2).
projection.liveComparison: Not evaluated (live rows not in sealed packet).

uncertainties: D1 requires the lexicon term in 'the product name or a primary pack claim'; here 'Tiefenreinigungsshampoo' appears only on the manufacturer DE page (no pack evidence in packet). Treated the manufacturer lead claim as a primary claim; if not, usageRole becomes alternating, D2 not_flagged, intensity still clarifying.
D1 lexicon matching: 'Tiefenreinigungsshampoo'/'tiefenreinigende' are compound/inflected forms of 'Tiefenreinigung'/'Tiefenreinigend'; treated as matches.
C1 is written for alkyl ether sulfates; standard does not say how a non-ethoxylated alkyl sulfate (ALS) with late betaine is treated.
deep_cleanser_listing note needs an existing deep-cleanser product ID; the sealed packet has no catalog data, so 'needs_record' is recorded provisionally.
Neighbor recording drives T4: a moderate-confidence W low necessarily names moderate as neighbor and therefore flags fine.
